decision.summary: A multi-sample coupled E-N shift occurs at indices 610–612: E decreases sharply (~1.5 MAD units), N increases sharply (~2.1 MAD units). The change is sustained through the end of the allowed context (index 667) with no return to prior baseline, so a temporary offset cannot be confirmed; status is uncertain pending observation beyond 667. No other temporary offsets are evident in the allowed context.
